note: Findings from the inheritance survey, filed by the enterprise against division constitutions and never applied. Under A3 the enterprise proposes and each division's lawmakers dispose.

amendments.raised_by: Numerals group compliance office, inheritance survey 1.0.0
amendments.finding: The enterprise states NM-101 as a floor and the division provision(s) named state the same duty as an ordinary provision that a division risk owner may accept. Under minimum harmonisation a division may not be looser than the enterprise.
amendments.proposed: Restate the named division provisions as absolute, or narrow them and add an absolute limb.
amendments.why_not_applied: The division constitutions are frozen revisions with executed corpora. Re-classifying a division provision changes which cases short-circuit under A6; only that division's lawmakers may do it (A3). Until they do, the enterprise states the duty ordinarily and records that a floor was proposed.
